lines: This was said by the Buddha, the Perfected One: that is what I heard.
“Mendicants, a mendicant with three qualities has slipped free of Māra’s dominion and dazzles like the sun.
It’s when they have the entire spectrum of the adept’s ethics, immersion, and wisdom.
A mendicant with these three qualities has slipped free of Māra’s dominion and dazzles like the sun.”
has slipped free of Māra’s dominion
This too is a matter that was spoken by the Blessed One: that is what I heard.
